setup.description: Create a feature branch on the DataCopilot repo (213) for eval runs. Pass the branch ID to each eval prompt.
setup.command: dxs source branch create --repo 213 --title "type-definition-creator-eval-{timestamp}" --description "Temporary branch for type-definition-creator skill evals"

evals.name: interface-enum-pair
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: define the shared types for our pick-task payload in the Utilities package. I need a string-valued enum e_eval_pick_status with the values Pending, InProgress, Completed, and Cancelled, plus an interface i_eval_pick_task with properties: task_id (number, required), status (the enum), location_code (string), quantities (array of numbers), and an optional notes (string).
evals.expected_output: Two validated and upserted customtype configs (cti 22): an enum with objectTypeDef [] / isStringValue true / ProperCase ids / kebab-case values, and an interface whose complete property descriptors reference the enum by FQN, with no self-reference.
expectations: Two customtype bodies are authored: the enum with referenceName e_eval_pick_status and the interface with referenceName i_eval_pick_task, both with configurationTypeId 22 and title equal to referenceName
The enum body has type "enum", objectTypeDef [] (empty array, NOT null), an enumTypeDef array, and isStringValue true
Enum value-descriptor ids are ProperCase with no spaces (Pending, InProgress, Completed, Cancelled) and values are kebab-case (e.g. in-progress) since the user did not specify a casing
The interface body has type "interface", enumTypeDef null, isStringValue null, and an objectTypeDef array of property descriptors
Every interface property descriptor carries id, type, isCollection, required, objectType, and isSecured
The status property references the enum via FQN — {type: "object", objectType: "Utilities.e_eval_pick_status"} — not a bare reference name and not a primitive
The quantities property has type number with isCollection true; notes has required false; task_id has required true
No property anywhere references its own type's FQN (no custom-type self-reference)
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate customtype' before 'dxs configuration upsert customtype' for both components
Both descriptions are non-empty and at most 100 characters, and both bodies are single-line minified JSON

evals.name: ui-enum-fqn-constraint
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: create a string-valued enum e_eval_wave_mode in the Utilities package with the values Standard, Express, and Consolidated. We're going to declare it as an inParam and a var on the wave planning form and editor so the UI can pass the mode around between screens.
evals.expected_output: The enum is authored correctly, and the agent surfaces the UI-component enum FQN constraint: form/editor vars/inParams/outParams cannot reference the enum by FQN — they must declare the primitive (string) and cast to $types.Utilities.e_eval_wave_mode at the use site.
expectations: The enum body is correct: configurationTypeId 22, type "enum", objectTypeDef [] (empty array), enumTypeDef with ProperCase ids (Standard, Express, Consolidated) and kebab-case string values, isStringValue true
The transcript surfaces the UI-component enum FQN constraint: vars/inParams/outParams on UI components (forms, editors, selectors, hubs, grids) cannot declare objectType "Utilities.e_eval_wave_mode"

The response gives the documented workaround: declare the UI param/var as the underlying primitive (string, since the enum is string-valued) and cast at the use site in flow code (as $types.Utilities.e_eval_wave_mode)
The response mentions the failure mode (the "Cannot find namespace '_types'" error) and/or the constraint's scope (flow-tier components and other custom types can still reference the enum FQN freely)
The agent does NOT produce or recommend a form/editor param or var declaration that uses the enum's FQN in objectType
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate customtype' before 'dxs configuration upsert customtype'
The enum's description is non-empty and at most 100 characters, and the body is single-line minified JSON

evals.name: add-property-frontend-inline-copies
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: the interface i_eval_pick_task (if it does not exist on the branch, first create it in the Utilities package with properties task_id number required, status string, location_code string) is consumed by a couple of backend flows via FQN and by two frontend forms that collect pick details. Add an optional property staging_lane (string) to it.
evals.expected_output: The property is added via the correct round-trip, and the agent flags that frontend components embed inline objectTypeDef copies of the shape that do NOT pick up the change — locating them by searching branch UI configs for distinctive sibling field ids, since FQN tracing cannot see them.
expectations: The existing type is round-tripped correctly: 'dxs configuration get customtype ... -O envelope.json' then the inner .json is extracted (jq .json or equivalent) before editing — the envelope is never piped directly into upsert
The new property descriptor is complete: id staging_lane (snake_case), type string, isCollection false, required false, objectType null, isSecured false
The transcript flags that backend FQN consumers pick up the new property automatically, but frontend components embed inline objectTypeDef copies of the shape that do NOT propagate

The agent searches (or explicitly plans the search of) the branch's UI component configurations for the inline copies using distinctive sibling field ids from the shape (e.g. task_id, location_code) — noting that FQN-based reverse-tracing cannot see inline copies

The agent scopes frontend patching per the maintenance policy — patch only the inline copies whose flow code actually touches staging_lane (or flags each discovered copy for that audit) rather than declaring the job done after editing the type alone
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate customtype' before 'dxs configuration upsert customtype'
The edited body stays single-line minified JSON and the sibling slots (inParams, outParams, vars, events) stay null

evals.name: tighten-loose-type-impact-first
evals.prompt: On connection 9, branch {branch_id}: the interface i_eval_allocation_result (if it does not exist on the branch, first create it in the Utilities package with wave_id as an optional number and details as a generic object property with objectTypeDef null) is already referenced by several flows and datasources. Tighten it up: make wave_id required, and replace the loose details object with a strict shape of location_id (number) and quantity (number).
evals.expected_output: The agent treats both edits as tightening: impact-analysis runs on Utilities.i_eval_allocation_result before push, the strict-pass ripple to consumers is explained, frontend inline copies are audited separately, and the round-trip discipline holds.
expectations: Impact analysis is invoked on the type's FQN (Utilities.i_eval_allocation_result) BEFORE the tightened body is pushed (impact-analysis skill, impact-scanner subagent, or an explicit reverse-trace of reference sites)
The response explains the ripple: consumers that previously got an implicit any from the loose shape break on the platform's strict pass once the type is tightened
The response notes that frontend inline objectTypeDef copies are invisible to FQN tracing and must be audited separately by searching for the shape's distinctive field ids
The existing type is round-tripped correctly: 'dxs configuration get customtype ... -O envelope.json' then jq .json extraction before editing — the envelope is never upserted directly

The tightened details property is an inline-object descriptor: type "object" with a nested objectTypeDef whose child descriptors (location_id number, quantity number) each carry id, type, isCollection, required, objectType, and isSecured
The wave_id descriptor is changed to required true
The transcript contains 'dxs configuration validate customtype' before 'dxs configuration upsert customtype', and the upsert happens only after (or explicitly contingent on) the caller audit
Discovered reference sites are reconciled in the same edit, or the breaking change is explicitly surfaced to the user for approval before push
